## What it is

The MaixCAM2 lens neck, shoulder, cap, and top recess.

## Design notes

The optical axis is the local Z axis and the seating plane is Z = 0 so the assembly can place it concentrically through the adapter opening.

## Don't

Keep the neck smaller than the cap and inside the adapter's 15 mm central opening.
